annotations.title: Request a list we don't carry

description: Ask for a niche and place that count_leads shows as empty or thin. Stores the request (deduped, a few a day per caller) and returns how many people asked for the same list. Does not build a list on the spot. Free.

email.description: Where to send word when it's built, if email alerts are on.

niche.description: A niche id or plain words, e.g. 'pool builders'.

q.description: Plain-English search, e.g. 'roofers in Dallas TX with no website'. Explicit fields below override what the sentence says.

state.description: US state, code or name. Required.

name: request_build
